title: Chapter 248 Death Mist
content:
Chapter 248 Death Mist

“Boom boom…!”

The five-star Zerg destroyers attacked faster, and the flying skeleton birds in the Skeleton Army were attacked fiercely before they could fully take off.

Those skeleton birds may not be able to fly for a long time, and need to stay on the ground first and take off when fighting. This is quite different from the Zerg flying dragons and the light griffins of the aliens.

No wonder the Naga did not specifically train a flying army. It is estimated that the pressure brought by the flying army of the Skeletons is not great.

The attack of 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers is amazing, and a large number of skeleton birds are cleared in an instant!

Many injured skeleton birds staggered and flew up, following the skeleton birds that took off in advance and escaped the disaster, and began to circle in the air.

Their current state is no longer suitable for attacking Zerg destroyers from the air.

This round of attack by the five-star Zerg destroyers destroyed at least a small half of the skeleton birds, making more than half of the skeleton birds lose their combat capability.

"Boom boom!"

The second round of large-scale attacks by the Zerg destroyers arrived, and countless liquid fireballs flew at high speed and evenly fell in the square formation of the entire Skeleton Army.

The liquid fireballs that were successfully intercepted and exploded in the army continued to injure and even kill the Skeleton soldiers who were already on guard.

The Skeleton Army, which was unable to effectively counterattack after two rounds of ultra-long-range fierce attacks by the Zerg destroyers, used all kinds of emergency measures.

Bursts of white mist quickly emerged in the square formation of the entire Skeleton Army, covering the surrounding area of the entire huge army.

Soon, the outside world could no longer see the situation in the Skeleton Army square formation.

Wu Qing could feel that this white mist could interfere with the outside world's vision and perception, and was also beneficial to the soldiers of the Skeleton Army.

"This is the Death Mist of the Undead race that believes in the God of Death!"

"It is one of the most powerful war magics of the Skeleton Clan!"

"The Death Mist can create an environment that is conducive to the combat of the Undead race, enhance the strength of the Undead army, and interfere with the combat of other races!"

"Now, general detection methods cannot see the specific situation of the Skeleton Clan army!"

"This is also the reason why we don't specify attack targets for you!"

"Under the cover of the Death Mist, the Skeleton Clan army will soon launch a full-scale attack!"

"Your attack range can be appropriately moved forward a certain distance!"

Naga explained to Host No. 3.

According to Wu Qing's understanding, this Death Mist should be a battlefield magic similar to the magic blessing and luck blessing, and is one of the most important battlefield means of the Skeleton Clan army.

But the Zerg has the host, a rule-level anti-stealth army, and any type of stealth method is ineffective against them.

Therefore, Wu Qing can still clearly grasp the real-time situation of the Skeleton Clan army.

The Death Mist was everywhere. After the severely damaged Skeleton Birds of the Skeleton Clan took off, they did not immediately fly towards the Zerg Destroyer, but hid in the mist.

The Skeleton Clan army is very clear about the strength of the Naga Clan's air defense force. With the current strength of the flying troops, rushing up like this is tantamount to suicide.

Wu Qing found that in the Death Mist, the injuries of the Skeleton Clan's soldiers were recovering rapidly, and their abilities in self-healing, action speed, attack and defense, etc., have been improved to a certain extent.

With the cover and blessing of the Death Mist, the entire Skeleton Clan army is in action, and the melee troops and cavalry troops are advancing rapidly, preparing to charge the Naga Clan army.

Other troops are also advancing in an orderly manner and pressing towards the Naga Clan army.

"Boom boom!"

The third round of Zerg destroyers' attack fell. With the influence of the Death Mist, the killing efficiency of this round of attacks really dropped a lot.

But the attack of 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers was still unstoppable and powerful. This time, Wu Qing chose the square formation of the Skeleton Mage.

Wu Qing had seen the power of magic attacks. The impact on the battlefield was very large, so he had to clear them out as much as possible.

Under the concentrated fire of 5,000 five-star Zerg destroyers, the Skeleton Mage's strength of the Skeleton Army was instantly halved. The insufficient Skeleton Mage died in large numbers. Other Skeleton Mage masters were also affected by the attack, and many wounded appeared.

More than 300,000 Zerg destroyers were already firing at full force. Zerg destroyers of different star strengths had different attack speeds.

In the time required for a round of attack by a one-star Zerg destroyer, the five-star Zerg destroyer had already launched two rounds of attacks.

Among them, there were also two-star, three-star, and four-star Zerg destroyers, and their attack speeds were different.

After the Queen controlled several rounds of volleys, the Zerg Destroyers' attacks became continuous, and each star strength attacked freely according to its own attack speed.

"Boom...!"

"Boom...!"

The attacks of Zerg Destroyers of other stars were controlled by the Queen, and Wu Qing only focused on the attack targets of the five-star Zerg Destroyers.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers used another volley to cripple the Skeleton Mage Army of the Skeleton Army, and then shifted their targets to the Skeleton Cavalry and Skeleton Archer Phalanxes in turn.

Faced with the attacks of the Zerg destroyers, the Skeleton Army had no effective response and could only follow the rapid expansion of the Death Mist and continue to advance in the direction of the Naga Army.

With the influence of the Death Mist, the Skeleton Army could still tolerate the losses caused by the attacks of other Zerg destroyers, except for the concentrated fire attacks of the five-star Zerg destroyers.

The siege weapon units of the Naga Army have been firing at full force and indiscriminately attacking the Death Mist. Their status has been greatly reduced due to the participation of the Zerg destroyers, and they are no longer the focus of attention.

The Zerg destroyers' attack coverage has been moving in the direction of the Naga Army's square formation, which is to obey the orders of the Naga tribe, and is equivalent to indicating the location of the Skeleton Army in disguise.

In fact, without the Zerg's instructions, the Naga Army also knows the tactics of the Skeleton Army very well, and there are not many secrets between the two tribes.

The Naga Army's deployment of troops has long taken this situation into consideration, and various targeted arrangements are very reasonable.

Even if Wu Qing is not disturbed by the Death Mist at all, he has to deploy troops in this way in the face of this situation.

Fighting with powerful and reliable allies feels very good. Wu Qing only needs to control the firepower output of the Zerg Destroyer and kill the most threatening arms of the Skeleton Army as much as possible.

Then provide long-range support to the Naga friendly forces according to the real-time battle situation, which is very worry-free.

Five thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers, as if they have eyes, take turns to attack the important arms in the Skeleton Army phalanx, constantly consuming the combat power of the Skeleton Army.

The edge of the Death Mist is about to spread to the Naga Army. A huge luck formation similar to the luck formation diagram in the Naga Army is opened to isolate the Death Mist.

The Naga warriors and the foreign long-range arms in the Naga Army began to launch blind attacks into the Death Mist.

Wu Qing saw that these blind attacks were actually very accurate and all hit the location of the Skeleton Army.

The long-range attack arms in the Skeleton Army also began to counterattack.

With the interference of the Death Mist, the killing efficiency of the one-star Zerg Destroyer decreased, and the number of deaths and injuries decreased.

Wu Qing commanded the five-star Zerg Destroyer to help the Naga army clear the threat.

The Queen arranged the Zerg Destroyers of other stars reasonably to cooperate with the attacks of the one-star Zerg Destroyers to improve the killing efficiency.

There are more than 300,000 Zerg Destroyers, which is a very large base. Up to now, basically every soldier of the Skeleton Army has been injured by the Zerg Destroyer attack, but the injuries vary.

This has a very serious impact on the overall combat power of the Skeleton Army.

The continuous damage of the corrosive mucus produced by the Zerg Destroyer attack completely offset the advantage gained by the Skeleton Army due to the Death Mist.

What's more terrifying is that before we know it, the Skeleton Army's manpower reduction is approaching one million!

When the Death Mist of the Skeletons encountered the Qiyun Formation of the Naga Tribe, and the long-range arms of both sides attacked each other, the melee arms and cavalry of the Skeletons launched a high-speed charge.

The melee troops in the front of the Naga army, with the blessing of various Qiyun secrets, were ready for defense.

In the past battlefields, the Naga army would also charge at this time to fight to the death with the Skeletons, but now with the ultra-long-range attack advantage of the Zerg Destroyers, the Naga army is not in a hurry to fight the Skeletons.

"Focus on this area closest to our formation!"

"Fight three rounds first!"

Naga conveyed the order of the Naga high-level to host No. 3.

The five thousand five-star Zerg Destroyers commanded by Wu Qing immediately launched a round of attacks on the charging Skeleton Cavalry. In the previous attacks, the Skeleton Cavalry, which had been the focus of Wu Qing's attention, suffered heavy casualties and lost most of its troops, with almost everyone injured.

The attacks of other Zerg destroyers controlled by the Queen followed closely, densely covering the Death Mist area in front of the front of the Naga army. The violent explosion impact had some impact on the Naga army.

A lot of corrosive mucus fell on the ground in front of the front of the Naga army, making a sizzling sound.

"Boom...!"

"Boom...!"

"..."

The Skeleton melee troops and cavalry units rushed to the front of the Naga army with difficulty despite the dense attacks of the Zerg destroyers and launched an attack on the Naga army.

The two tribes fought hand-to-hand, and the melee broke out. The Zerg destroyers' attacks could not get too close to friendly forces, and could no longer affect the Skeleton soldiers in the battle.

The Zerg destroyers continued to carry out fierce blocking attacks to control the strength of the Skeleton army rushing towards the Naga army.

Even if the soldiers of the Skeleton Army rushed through the Zerg Destroyer's fire coverage area, they became wounded with their combat effectiveness greatly reduced. When fighting against the Naga Army's full-state melee troops, they were completely at a disadvantage.
